title: Fix English translations for fixed homepage header banner title and subtitle

requirements.summary: Update the English translation for `header.title` so the fixed homepage header banner title matches the required exact wording.
acceptanceCriteria: When the selected language is English (`en`) and the user visits the homepage, the large fixed header title text shows exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & Get GPS Leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice".
No other user-facing header title text in English shows the old wording (e.g., "Get Leader-Giotag" or "Civic Reporter") in the fixed header banner.

file_operations.description: In the `en` translations map, change the `header.title` value from the current text to exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & Get GPS Leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice" (this is rendered via `t('header.title')` in `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx`).

requirements.summary: Update the English translation for `header.subtitle` so the fixed homepage header banner subtitle matches the required exact wording without changing layout behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: When the selected language is English (`en`), the fixed header subtitle shows exactly: "Help improve our India by reporting civic issues".
The subtitle remains a single-line truncated subtitle in the header (no layout break/regression from current behavior).

file_operations.description: In the `en` translations map, change the `header.subtitle` value from the current text to exactly: "Help improve our India by reporting civic issues". Do not change `Header.tsx` structure/styles so the existing single-line truncate behavior remains unchanged.
